items.raw_excerpt: Summers are getting hotter in Austria, and temperatures have already soared past 30C. Here's how not to let it affect your sleep.
items.summary_en: Summers in Austria are getting hotter. Temperatures have already passed 30C. Here is how to sleep well in the heat.

items.raw_excerpt: Burger lovers have a new reason to visit Albufeira this summer as the Portugal Burger Cup – Summer Edition arrives at Parque do Ribeiro from 1 to 10 August, bringing together burgers inspired by eight different countries in a friendly culinary competition.
items.summary_en: Albufeira gets a new burger festival this summer. The Portugal Burger Cup Summer Edition runs from 1 to 10 August at Parque do Ribeiro. It will bring burgers inspired by eight countries in a fun food competition.

items.raw_excerpt: North Yorkshire Council has already refused planning permission for the gas drilling rig in Burniston.
items.summary_en: A company wants to build a gas drilling rig in the village of Burniston. North Yorkshire Council has already refused the planning permit once. Now the public is being asked for its views again.
items.summary_ko: 한 회사가 번스턴 마을에 가스 시추 장비를 세우려고 한다. 노스요크셔 의회는 이미 이 시추 허가를 한 번 거절했다. 이제 주민들의 의견을 다시 듣고 있다.

items.title_original: Public views sought on village gas drilling permit - Yahoo

items.raw_excerpt: More than two dozen farmers in the Netherlands are growing quinoa, a South American seed that copes with salt far better than the crops usually planted on coastal land. Salt is a worsening problem around the Dutch coast, with too little fresh water flowing to hold back the sea, and salt also seeps up from the ground in dry conditions. items.summary_en: More than 20 Dutch farmers now grow quinoa, a seed from South America. It grows well in salty coastal soil that destroys potatoes and onions. Supermarket Jumbo now sells quinoa from Groningen instead of Peru.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 농부 20여 명이 남아메리카에서 온 퀴노아를 재배하고 있다. 이 씨앗은 감자와 양파를 망가뜨리는 해안가 짠 땅에서도 잘 자란다. 슈퍼마켓 점보는 이제 페루 대신 그로닝언에서 난 퀴노아를 판다.
items.title_en: Farmers in Groningen grow quinoa in salty soil

items.raw_excerpt: Leona Maguire will compete in her fourth Solheim Cup after Team Europe captain Anna Nordqvist named the Cavan golfer as one of her four wildcard picks for the event at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands from 11-13 September.
items.summary_en: Leona Maguire will play in her fourth Solheim Cup. Team Europe captain Anna Nordqvist chose her as one of four wildcard picks. The event is at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands from 11 to 13 September.
items.summary_ko: 레오나 맥과이어가 생애 네 번째 솔하임컵에 출전한다. 유럽팀 주장 아나 노드크비스트가 캐번 출신 골퍼를 와일드카드 네 명 중 한 명으로 뽑았다. 대회는 9월 11일부터 13일까지 네덜란드 베르나르두스 골프장에서 열린다.
items.title_en: Irish golfer Leona Maguire gets Solheim Cup wildcard pick
items.title_original: Maguire receives Solheim Cup wildcard pick

items.raw_excerpt: An MND summer intern didn't expect to travel much in Mexico. A 24-hour trip to Guanajuato changed his mind — and might change yours too.
items.summary_en: A Mexico News Daily summer intern did not expect to travel much in Mexico. A 24-hour trip to Guanajuato changed his mind. Now he recommends the city to readers.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite boasting five World Cup winners, the Millonario has lost five straight local games for the first time since 1911
items.summary_en: River Plate is a football club in Buenos Aires. It has five World Cup winners on its team. But it lost five local games in a row, the first time since 1911.

items.title_en: River Plate in worst local slump in 115 years

items.title_original: River Plate in worst domestic slump in 115 years despite World Cup-winning lineup

items.raw_excerpt: Private vehicles cannot access Bolafjall during Iceland’s August 12 solar eclipse. Visitors must use paid shuttle buses from Bolungarvík.
items.summary_en: Private cars cannot reach Bolafjall during Iceland's August 12 total solar eclipse. Visitors must use paid shuttle buses from Bolungarvik.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드 8월 12일 개기일식 당일 볼라피아들에는 승용차로 진입할 수 없습니다. 방문객은 볼룬가르비크에서 유료 셔틀버스를 이용해야 합니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Fertiliser co-operative Ravensdown is breaking its three-year fast on rebates for its farmer-shareholders, on the back of a return to profit.
items.summary_en: A New Zealand fertiliser co-operative has returned to profit. It will pay rebates to its farmer-shareholders again after a three-year pause. Fertiliser prices are now rising on farms.

items.title_en: Fertiliser Co-op Returns to Profit, Gives Farmers Rebates

items.title_original: Ravensdown's return to profit prompts shareholder rebate as fertiliser prices spike on-farm
